verdict: One invented keeper through four shots, cut on the song's beats. The face, hair and rust coat hold in shots 1, 2 and 4. Two flaws: in shot 3 the coat turns khaki on top, and she carries two lanterns where we asked for one. The lens she cleans in shot 2 came out as a glass globe, not a lighthouse lens. We checked the song by measurement only: no person has listened to it for this review.
peak_note: Peak is this run's own ComfyUI and tools, read from nvidia-smi every 2 seconds. The card was shared with other work. Time adds up each stage's own work, not the wait for the shared card.

values.lyrics:
[intro]

[verse]
I keep the lamp when the harbour sleeps
Salt on my hands and the promise it keeps
Nobody's sailing, nobody's near
I turn the light so you know I'm here
[chorus]
Burn on, burn on, over the black water
Burn on, burn on, till the morning comes
Every wave I count is a mile I've carried you
Burn on, burn on, I will bring you home
[outro]

Global Metadata
Basic Attributes: bpm is 84. key is A, and scale is minor. Cinematic folk rock.
Global Emotional Progression: A lone voice and acoustic guitar open quietly, then drums and strings lift the chorus into something huge.
Application Scenarios & Imagery: a tall black-and-white lighthouse on a storm-worn rock in a dark cold sea, the only light for miles.
Sonics & Production Profile: Close, warm vocal, wide room, deep low end.
Vocal Details
Vocal Gender & Timbre: Singer A (Female), husky and steady.
Vocal Style: Intimate in the verse, open and strong in the chorus.
Harmony/Backing Vocals: Soft stacked harmonies on the chorus.
Vocal FX: Light hall reverb.
Arrangement
Instrument Lifecycle Description (Primary/Secondary Layering):
Primary: Acoustic guitar, low piano.
Secondary: Strings and a slow-building drum kit.
Groove & Foundation Progression: A clear 84 BPM pulse from the first bars, full drums on the chorus.
Embellishments, Textures & Spatial FX: Swells and rises into each new section.

stages.label: The character

stages.prompt: Full body character design: a woman in her forties with short silver hair and a weathered face, a long rust-orange oilskin coat over a dark green fisherman's sweater, heavy black boots. Standing, facing the camera, the whole figure in frame, plain light grey studio background, soft even light. No text, no logos.
